# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/railway
# args: 
Create, delete or link an environment

Usage: railway environment [OPTIONS] [ENVIRONMENT] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  link    Link an environment to the current project
  new     Create a new environment [aliases: create, add]
  delete  Delete an environment [aliases: rm, remove]
  edit    Edit an environment's configuration [aliases: update]
  config  Show environment configuration [aliases: show, info]
  list    List all environments in the project [aliases: ls]
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Arguments:
  [ENVIRONMENT]  The environment to link to

Options:
      --json     Output in JSON format
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

Examples:

  railway environment list --json
  railway environment new staging --json
  railway environment create staging --duplicate production --json
  railway environment delete staging --yes --json
  railway environment config --environment production --json

Automation notes:
  After creating an environment, verify the linked target with `railway status --json`.
  Destructive non-interactive runs must pass the environment and --yes.
